reasons: The cited § 2.1 is a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay with express denial of reduction or termination rights — squarely the rule's walk-away position, so a deviation finding is correctly classified.

The redline reaches the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees only for Services ordered or actually used) and ties back to § 7.1, keeping the drafting consistent with the existing payment clause and Vendor's § 12.3 acknowledgement of no minimum-volume commitment.

The failed minimal-edit check (0.970 changed-character ratio) is expected here: the entire operative sentence is the offending take-or-pay obligation, so deletion/replacement is the smallest edit that achieves the playbook position.

The comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, correctly prefixed, explains the change, cites the internal contradiction, and offers the 12-month reducible commitment with true-up as the fallback without lecturing.
